annotations.title: Create an Event with a guest link

description: Create an Event (a dinner, a party, a class trip…) with the things people should bring, each with a quantity. Returns a guest link: guests open it in any browser, no app or account, and claim items with their first name. For "a birthday lunch with 12 guests", suggest items sized for 12.

date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) or local date and time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm), as the host means it — no time zone

items.description: What guests can bring, with how many are needed

name: create_event
